text: On Apollo thirteen, three astronauts were in danger because a square filter wouldn't fit a round hole.
In their lunar module lifeboat, carbon dioxide from their breath was building up.
The lunar module took round canisters to scrub it out. The spares from the command module were square.
So engineers on the ground built an adapter, using only what was on board. Plastic bags, cardboard, a hose, a sock, and duct tape.
The crew copied it from instructions over the radio, and the carbon dioxide started to fall.
